title: Austin City Budget & Public Works (1902)
summary:
• **Tax & Fee Refunds Granted** – The council approved a refund of occupation taxes to B.J. Campbell and referred several other refund requests from citizens to committees for review.

• **Infrastructure & Safety Projects Funded** – The city allocated $50 for surveying the western city boundary, $150 for cemetery fence repairs, $250 for extra labor and teams, and approved a 500-foot fire hose purchase.

• **Regulations on Fire Safety** – Council introduced an ordinance to regulate the storage of hay and other combustible materials within city fire limits, referred to committee for further review.

• **Mayor's Congratulations** – The council unanimously passed a resolution congratulating Mayor R.E. White on his recent marriage, wishing him happiness and prosperity.

• **Street Naming & Financial Transfers** – Council retained "Pitts Avenue" as an official street name and transferred $857 between municipal accounts to manage bonded debt and water interest payments.

and returned from the scenes of 'Boy Hoods happy days' his old home in Tennessee and
